selection: Nonterminal model step 10; exactly 10 images x 2040 tokens; L31 H0 complete mean over all output tokens; one decision per task

entropy.caution: Selected step-10 cohort; descriptive and exploratory, no causal claim.

position_ranking.method: Mean per-task image share at nonterminal model step 10. Positions are exact recorded image-input order, 1 oldest to 10 latest. Rank positions 1-9 only; shares retain normalization over all 10 images. One task has one vote. Source-step ambiguities do not change input-position identity.
